开花是什么异能？还特么是黑色的？玩老子呢！？

剧情中原主是火系异能，杀伤力很强，但没有晶核升级，所以到死她的异能也不过二级，可是怎么到她这儿就成了这么个没见过的异能？？

时笙试了好几次，每次不是开出一朵黑色小花，就是开出两朵黑色小花，坑爹有木有？

火系异能怎么会变成这样？变异也不带这样的啊！

时笙思索了良久，最终想起她之前和屋里那只丧尸打的时候，好像吃了什么东西，不会是那东西造成她现在这个样子的吧？

天呐，本宝宝这是造的什么孽。

系统求金手指，我要炫酷加特技的！

“啊！”女人的尖叫声响彻大街。

几个年轻男女从街角冲出来，他们身后跟着七八只丧尸，兴奋的‘嗬嗬’追着食物跑。

而就在此时，他们前面的马路上，摇摇晃晃的走过来几只丧尸，听到声音，顿时齐刷刷的朝着奔跑的几人看过来，随后兴奋的朝着他们围堵过来。

“余哥，怎么办？”问话是一个胖子，手中拎着一把斧子。

前有狼，后有虎，难道他们今天就要交代在这里？

“上面有人。”其中一个妹纸突然指着街道旁边的二楼，“余哥，那里有人。”

被叫做余哥的人抬头看去。

这一片的是老城区，老式的建筑二楼有一个很大的阳台，还是露天的。此时那阳台就站着一个人，那是一个少女，看年纪也不过十六七的样子，身上穿着干净的运动服，怀中抱着一只白色的猫。

余良觉得有些怪异，但是此时生死关头，他也没空细想，朝着二楼的下面看去，那里有个铁门，看上去很结实。

附近的门要不是紧闭的，要不就是被破坏了，余良只得对着二楼喊道：“这位姑娘，能不能为我们开一下门。”

两边的丧尸越来越近。

“开门，快让我们上去。”之前那个喊有人的妹纸也出声了，不过语气不怎么好。

“姑娘，大家都是同类，能帮一把就帮一把，我们身上有吃的，可以分给你，姑娘，你快帮我们开一下门，丧尸就要来了。”

“你是不是聋了，说句话啊！”

可不管他们怎么说，站在阳台上的少女，没有半点动静。如果不是她怀中的那只猫在不断的甩着尾巴，他们都怀疑那个少女只是个雕像，根本就不是个人。

而丧尸已经到了。

What is the power of blooming?And it’s black?Playing with me!?

In the plot, the original owner has fire-type powers, which is very lethal, but she has no crystal core upgrade, so her powers will only be at the second level until the end of her life. But how come she has such an unprecedented power??

Shi Sheng tried several times, but each time either one small black flower bloomed or two small black flowers bloomed. Is this a scam?

How could fire powers become like this?Mutations are not like this!

Shi Sheng thought for a long time, and finally remembered that she seemed to have eaten something when she was fighting the zombie in the room. Couldn't that be what caused her to be like this?

God, what kind of evil has this baby done?

The system is looking for a golden finger, I want someone who is cool and has special skills!

"Ah!" the woman's scream echoed through the street.

Several young men and women rushed out from the street corner, followed by seven or eight zombies, chasing the food with excitement.

At this moment, several zombies staggered over on the road in front of them. When they heard the sound, they all immediately looked at the running people, and then excitedly surrounded them.

"Brother Yu, what should I do?" The question came from a fat man holding an ax in his hand.

There are wolves in front and tigers in the back. Are they going to explain here today?

"There's someone up there." One of the girls suddenly pointed to the second floor next to the street, "Brother Yu, there's someone there."

The man called Brother Yu looked up.

This area is in the old city. The old-fashioned building has a large balcony on the second floor, which is open-air.At this time, there was a person standing on the balcony. She was a girl, who looked to be no more than sixteen or seventeen years old. She was wearing clean sportswear and holding a white cat in her arms.

Yu Liang felt a little weird, but at this critical moment of life and death, he had no time to think about it. He looked down on the second floor. There was an iron door there, which looked very strong.

The nearby door was either closed or damaged, so Yu Liang had no choice but to shout to the second floor: "Girl, can you open the door for us?"

The zombies on both sides are getting closer and closer.

"Open the door and let us up quickly." The girl who called someone before also spoke out, but her tone was not very good.

"Girl, we are all of the same kind, so if you can help, please do so. We have food with us that we can share with you. Girl, please open the door for us quickly, the zombies are coming."

"Are you deaf? Say something!"

But no matter what they said, the girl standing on the balcony did not move at all.If it weren't for the cat in her arms that kept flicking its tail, they would have suspected that the girl was just a statue and not a person at all.

And the zombies have arrived.
